name: Aozora Hisae
source: She is [url=https://vndb.org/c338]Haruka's[/url] grandmother and one of the two original founders of Eiden Academy. After passing of her husband, she continued his legacy in search of the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Nowadays she is the principal of Eiden Academy.
translation: She is [url=https://vndb.org/c338]Haruka's[/url] grandmother and one of the two original founders of Eiden Academy. After passing of her husband, she continued his legacy in search of the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Nowadays she is the principal of Eiden Academy.
